events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran is expected to impact global markets, particularly oil prices. The US and its allies are involved in the conflict, which may lead to further escalation. The situation is being closely monitored by investors and policymakers.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran is likely to lead to higher oil prices, which may impact the global economy. Investors are advised to buy the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) as a hedge against potential market volatility. On the other hand, the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) may be shorted as oil prices may fluctuate.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict is resolved or oil prices stabilize
